intro: Your face routine does not reach every place that gets sweaty or congested. SPOTLESS spreads a salicylic-acid lotion across hard-to-reach body skin. The proposed 0.5% formula pairs a beta hydroxy acid with niacinamide and humectants in a sealed cloth. It is a body-skin routine step, not an overnight cure or a replacement for diagnosis.

steps.title: Reach body skin
steps.body: A single cloth spreads lotion over chest, shoulders, or upper back without a bottle, cotton rounds, or a second pair of hands.

steps.title: Exfoliate carefully
steps.body: The proposed lotion contains 0.5% salicylic acid. The amount retained on skin after wiping has not been measured.

steps.title: Keep the routine comfortable

mechanism.proof: Proposed lotion: 0.5% salicylic acid. A pass with a saturated cloth is followed by air-dry, leave-on contact. Concentration alone does not establish drug compliance or the amount transferred from the cloth. Do not present wipe time as a clinical contact-time claim.

outcomes.body: A clean, lightly conditioned feel. A tingle can occur; stinging is a reason to stop. No visible clearing is promised.
Consistency matters more than scrubbing. Begin conservatively and do not stack strong exfoliants without advice.
Skin may look smoother, or it may not. No transformation, fixed lesion reduction, or clearance timeline is promised.

howToUse: Gently pass over intact chest, shoulders, or back. Avoid eyes, lips, mucosa, and broken skin. Do not scrub.
Let the lotion air-dry; do not rinse. Bin the wipe. Start every other day if sensitive and use sunscreen on exposed skin.

perspective.body: The American Academy of Dermatology explains that salicylic acid opens clogged pores and exfoliates skin. That supports the ingredient mechanism, not a claim that this particular wipe treats acne. Deep, painful, or scarring lesions need a dermatologist.
perspective.source: American Academy of Dermatology · Acne treatment
perspective.disclaimer: This independent guidance informs the ingredient and use decision. It is not an endorsement of Wipelo or this product.

ingredients.intro: Current development formula; check the finished product label before use. Finished-wipe delivery, stability, and final INCI order must be verified.

tabs.title: Salicylic acid
tabs.body: A beta hydroxy acid in the proposed lotion at 0.5%. It exfoliates and can help unclog pores. It does not establish finished-product acne-treatment status or clear cysts overnight.

tabs.title: Niacinamide + zinc PCA
tabs.body: Ingredients selected for skin conditioning and oil-look support. They do not replace acne medicines or prove reduced sebum for this wipe.

tabs.title: Glycerin + panthenol
tabs.body: Humectant and conditioning support for the feel of an acid routine. They do not make irritation impossible.

tabs.title: Cloth
tabs.body: Proposed viscose or viscose/lyocell cloth, around 60 gsm and saturated to about 400% of dry weight. Verify salicylic-acid stability and delivered dose after contact with the chosen fiber.

faqs.question: Is it safe for sensitive or intimate skin?
faqs.answer: This is for intact external body skin only, not genital or other mucosal skin. Salicylic acid can dry or irritate. Patch test and start slowly. For children, ask a pediatric clinician before use; this formula has no age-specific safety data.

faqs.question: Does it replace washing or my acne treatment?
faqs.answer: No. Cleanse normally after heavy sweat when you can. If you use prescription or over-the-counter acne medicine, ask your clinician before layering another acid, especially on large areas.

faqs.question: Will it clear body acne in four weeks?
faqs.answer: No fixed timeline is promised. Body bumps can have different causes, including folliculitis or keratosis pilaris. Painful, deep, spreading, or scarring lesions need a clinician.

faqs.question: How does the subscription work?
faqs.answer: The product brief proposes 10% savings and a free first-order Welcome Kit. Recurring orders are not available until a Shopify subscription app and selling plan are configured.

faqs.question: What if it does not work for me?
faqs.answer: The proposed First Pack Promise gives you 30 days from delivery to contact support for a refund of the first order. Confirm the final policy terms with the store before purchase.
